description: This file contains unit tests for the ChatController's message ID reconciliation logic within the chat application. It verifies that message IDs are correctly reused or maintained when reloading chat history or processing new messages.

classes.name: ChatControllerMessageIdentityTest
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for verifying message ID reconciliation in chat message histories.

methods.name: reconcileMessageIdsReusesMatchingIdsAcrossHistoryReload
methods.description: Tests that message IDs are reused when the messages match in previous history and incoming messages during a reload.

methods.name: reconcileMessageIdsLeavesNewMessagesUntouched
methods.description: Ensures that new messages are assigned new IDs and existing message IDs are preserved.
